basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer | AI-Integrated Web Applications | Python, TypeScript & Vue
basics.summary: Full-stack developer who ships both the UI and the data layer underneath it: Python and TypeScript on the backend, Vue on the front, PostgreSQL and Elastic Search for storage and search. I integrate LLMs into production applications as a matter of course: AI Brain at LumApps is a metadata and knowledge layer unifying 5+ data sources with access contracts and freshness governance built in, the same data lifecycle problem a metadata management platform solves. At Beekeeper I designed and shipped REST APIs and full-stack features end to end (Employee Referral System, Distributed Templating Engine) for 10M+ users in an Agile team, with CI/CD via GitHub Actions and Jenkins. 13+ years building user-facing tools that data teams and business users both rely on daily.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Designed AI Brain, a metadata and knowledge management layer (temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j) unifying 5+ data sources (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage), with a per-source access contract and a freshness layer that flags stale data, the same lifecycle and interoperability problem a metadata management platform solves.

Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, integrating LLMs directly into a customer-facing application with tools exposed over MCP servers. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities. Forecast: $1M in quarterly revenue at 25% conversion.

Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, tracing, tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, evaluating and adopting new AI techniques as the field moved.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the engineering team around me.
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end: Vue frontend, Java and PostgreSQL backend, REST APIs. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA.

Designed distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90% and now powers 15% of all platform assets for 10M+ users. Full-stack ownership, front to back, with user experience as the design constraint.
Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams on Elastic Search: redesigned indexing and ranking to surface what users mean to find, not just what they typed. Measurable lift in user engagement.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline (GitHub Actions CI/CD, OpenAI APIs) built in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, engineering culture, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised multiple portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy, and building engineering cultures that actually ship.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live UX test for real-world systems.
Engineered real-time flight control REST APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Full-Stack Developer, Data Products team, Roche. Maintains and enhances an internal web application for metadata management over a medical data (clinical + real world data) sharing platform: FAIR data, data lifecycle management (onboarding, access/use restrictions, access requests, third-party access, contract expiration, deletion), plus tooling for the team. Gathers and prioritizes feature requests, designs technical solutions, integrates third-party tech, implements in Agile. Ideally brings: Python and modern JavaScript, AI/LLM integration experience and ML/AI fundamentals, modern web dev (Jamstack a plus), React/Next.js/Django, REST API design, SQL and relational DBs (ORM a plus), containers (Docker/Kubernetes a plus), Git-based team workflows, CI/CD a plus, Agile a plus, UX sensibility, web security awareness, ElasticSearch/OpenSearch a plus, AWS or another cloud a plus.
_jobApplication.notes: Good fit on the core, non-framework-specific asks: Python, REST API design, PostgreSQL/relational DBs, Elastic Search (a named nice-to-have, and genuinely used at Beekeeper), Docker, CI/CD, Agile, and real production LLM/AI integration (the JD's own most distinctive ask). Reframed LumApps' AI Brain around metadata management and data lifecycle governance since that is literally the product this team owns. Honest gaps: no React, Next.js, Django, Jamstack, or ORM experience documented in resume.md/resume.json; frontend history is Vue, not React. The JD frames its whole tech list as 'ideally,' not hard requirements, so this wasn't treated as a blocker, but it's worth naming directly if asked, since Vue is not a drop-in substitute for React/Next.js.
